name: facets
need: Filter a list from a panel of facets beside it: options with counts, a search inside long facets, ranges, applied chips and Clear all; a side sheet on phones

--ds-facets-width.description: the width of a facet panel beside its list (it grows to the row when it wraps)

--ds-facets-main-min.description: the least share of the row the list beside a facet panel keeps; the panel folds behind its Filters button when both do not fit

--ds-facets-gap.description: the gap between a facet panel and its list at size md and the comfortable density: 4px per size step, 2px per density step

--ds-facet-max-height.description: the height after which the options of a `.ds-facet--scroll` facet scroll

labExempt.DS.facets.create: options show and hide at once; its chips are input chips and its sheet the side sheet's motion
labExempt.DS.facets.foldText: a pure function of text: no motion
labExempt.DS.facets.visible: a pure function of the options: no motion
